task.title: Keep remote storage reads available during atomic writes
task.source: Live Raspberry Pi Android Chrome report and runtime logs
task.classification: remote runtime, persistent storage concurrency, and chat deletion

inScope: Reader availability during large collection writes
No-op connected-chat cleanup during chat deletion
outOfScope: Storage file, journal, manifest, or command format changes
Deletion of live user data for verification

claimBoundary.coreClaim: Readers can observe the complete pre-commit state while a large atomic update serializes and syncs replacement files, then observe the committed state after the short locked install.
claimBoundary.riskType: persistent storage concurrency, transaction durability, remote runtime availability, and chat deletion
legacyPathsOrFormats: Existing collection JSON files and append journals
Existing prepared and committed transaction recovery
outOfScopeClaims: This does not promise every storage write completes within a fixed deadline.
This does not change frontend timeout behavior.
This does not change any persistent format or deletion response.

contractLaneGate.brokenContract: src-tauri held the global storage RwLock while serializing and syncing large atomic replacement files, so unrelated and target readers could not service remote-runtime requests.
contractLaneGate.consumer: Remote-runtime storage commands and chat deletion
contractLaneGate.impliedContract: The src-tauri storage owner must preserve atomic writer ordering and durability without blocking readers during pre-commit file preparation.
contractLaneGate.actualEnforcement: The atomic WriteGate remains held for the whole update; dirty targets are flushed and replacement files are prepared outside the global RwLock; the RwLock is reacquired for stamp conflict validation, manifest installation, rename, sync, and cache installation.
contractLaneGate.primaryOwnerDetail: FileStorage owns native locking, transaction preparation, durability, recovery, and cache installation.
contractLaneGate.wrongLaneFixToAvoid: Do not widen the frontend timeout or hide failed requests; src-tauri owns the native lock duration that starved remote readers.
regressionProof: Full marinara-storage durability and recovery suite

positiveRows.claim: A target collection read finishes while replacement-file preparation is deliberately paused.
positiveRows.evidence: The focused regression failed before the implementation, passes after it, and passed ten repeated runs.

positiveRows.claim: The concurrent read sees the complete pre-commit row and a later read sees the committed row.
positiveRows.evidence: reads_continue_while_atomic_replacement_files_are_prepared asserts Before during preparation and After after commit.

positiveRows.claim: Disconnecting an already-unconnected chat does not replace chats.json.
positiveRows.evidence: disconnect_connected_chat_skips_unconnected_collection_rewrite compares exact file bytes before and after the command.

contradictionRows.claim: Concurrent writers must not enter while atomic replacement files are prepared.
contradictionRows.evidence: concurrent_message_append_waits_for_atomic_update_and_then_succeeds passes in the full storage suite.

contradictionRows.claim: Corrupt journals, conflicting stamps, partial installs, and recovery evidence must still fail closed.
contradictionRows.evidence: The 151-test marinara-storage suite passes all corruption, conflict, rollback, manifest, checkpoint, and recovery cases.

contradictionRows.claim: Real connected-chat links and notes must still be cleared.
contradictionRows.evidence: All four connected-chat command tests pass, including partner-link and connected-note cleanup.

legacyDefaultRows.claim: Existing storage files and recovery state require no migration.
legacyDefaultRows.evidence: No collection, journal, checkpoint, backup, or transaction manifest format changed.

legacyDefaultRows.claim: Existing replace_all_many callers retain their lock and install semantics.
legacyDefaultRows.evidence: replace_all_many_locked reuses the extracted prepare/install helpers while its callers and full storage suite remain green.

untestedRows: A destructive delete against real Pi user data is intentionally excluded; post-merge live proof uses health, image revision, mounts, mobile boot, and non-destructive invokes.

ownedFacts.description: A live Pi storage_delete held the storage path for 56.5 seconds while concurrent storage_list and storage_get calls took 18 to 21 seconds.
ownedFacts.evidence: Remote server operation logs captured start and completion timestamps for the Android Chrome session.

ownedFacts.description: Android Chrome requests abandoned during the stall and Nginx recorded HTTP 499 responses.
ownedFacts.evidence: Live Pi Nginx access logs for POST /api/invoke.

ownedFacts.description: Pi CPU and memory remained healthy while chats.json was about 37.7 MB, messages.json about 14 MB, and message-swipes.json about 13.5 MB.
ownedFacts.evidence: Live resource and collection-size inspection during diagnosis.

userActionCopy.description: No migration is required. Before any manual destructive storage experiment, copy the current De-Koi collection data to a separate backup folder.
userActionCopy.action: Copy the folder and verify the backup before running a destructive experiment; normal update and use require no action.
detectedLayouts: Existing collection JSON and transaction sidecars

manualBlockers.item: Destructive timing proof against real user chat data
manualBlockers.reason: The concurrency and no-op contracts are deterministic in focused tests; live user data will not be deleted to repeat the failure.
